authoritative_text.definition_summary: An exterior angle is the supplementary neighbor of a polygon interior angle.
authoritative_text.theorem: 49: take one exterior angle at every vertex of a convex polygon; their sum is 4d.
authoritative_text.proof_complete: Construct an exterior angle at every vertex (fig-236). Each interior angle plus its supplementary exterior angle is 2d. The sum of all interior and selected exterior angles is 2dn. Subtracting the stated interior sum 2d(n-2) gives 4d.
